feastLines.line: 🔥 The fire settles. the person in their 50s has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The absence of sound, shaped like wings — I put it down today." "No sound. That is the warning. The moon-shadow on the ground is growing — and there is no sound at all. Owls don't make sound when they hunt." "It missed — and it is already turning. The second dive re-aims at where you moved." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nikolai asks "Did it look at you? Before?" Patrick breathes "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — wha
💛 The Lucky Coin is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — quiet luck: 1 in 5 misses lands anyway, while worn.)
💛 The Mixtape is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — quiet luck: 1 in 5 misses lands anyway, while worn.)
💛 The Unnamed photograph is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — resolve: trauma lands a quarter lighter, while worn.)
💛 The Dispatcher's headset is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — resolve: trauma lands a quarter lighter, while worn.)

🔥 The fire settles. Nikolai has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Hummice — I put it down today." "A low hum rises from the grass. It harmonizes with itself. Your teeth ache." "Teeth in the grass, everywhere at once — a tide of small bites." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Robin says "So it bleeds." Brian says quietly "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

◈ RESONANCE HARMONICS — SYSTEM: "HYPOTHESIS CONFIRMED. Objects with high observer-attention waveforms function as auxiliary capacitors. We call this RESONANCE HARMONICS. We do not know why the waveforms taste like grief. We have stopped asking." — Hold a keepsake. Think about them. The System will do the math. (It is not math. It is love. The System will never know.) Channel keepsakes from your pack.

🔥 The fire settles. Patrick has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Hushpuppy — I put it down today." "No telegraph you can hear. Watch the birds — when they go quiet, the pack is already moving." "The pack circles — nips from the edge, never committing." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Robin says quietly "So it bleeds." Aki says quietly "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Aki has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nightlight — I put it down today." "A soft green glow under the water. Pretty. That's the problem — it's pretty." "The whiskers go rigid — then lash." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Somchai breathes "Did it look at you? Before?" Vy says quietly "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Brian has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Flashbulb Moth — I put it down today." "It lands. It folds its wings. The light in the clearing changes, like someone adjusting a lamp." "It lets go of the air and simply... drifts. Somewhere else. Hard to predict." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nikolai asks "And you're still standing." Robin mutters "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Aki has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Extended Warranty — I put it down today." "RING. RING. The sound is inside your skull. 'We have been trying to REACH you about your—'" "It dials faster. More voices. All of them want to talk about your coverage." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Desmond mutters "We've been walking past those." Vy breathes "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Vy has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Cliffhanger — I put it down today." "It goes perfectly still. Only the eyes move. Then the water explodes — and the world starts spinning." "It has your leg. The roll starts. Do NOT let it reach the water." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Desmond asks "Did it look at you? Before?" Aki mutters "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Patrick has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Living Wire — I put it down today." "The water goes glass-still. A faint crackling, and the hairs on your arms lift." "The crackling fades. It slides backward into the black water, done spending itself — for now." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Desmond says "We've been walking past those." Adriano says quietly "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Caleb has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Heckler — I put it down today." "'You call that a swing?' The words CUT. Shame stacks." "'Oh, it's TRYING again!' Double shame — it smells blood." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Vy asks "And you're still standing." Desmond asks "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

Caleb says quietly "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

Caleb mutters "And you're still standing." Joshua mutters "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
